name: DPS + proximal $x_0$ refinement + EMA
tagline: Combine DPS Jacobian guidance with iterative clean-space proximal refinement of $\hat x_0$, both smoothed by per-step EMA momentum.
diff_from_baseline: Adds two ingredients on top of DPS: an inner proximal-gradient loop refining $\hat x_0$ in the clean signal domain, and EMA momentum on both DPS and proximal updates; also injects mask-based pixel replacement for inpainting.

name: Momentum DPS via $x_0$ proxy loss
tagline: Run an inner gradient step on $\hat x_0$ to fit the measurement, then backprop a quadratic proxy loss to $x_t$ with bias-corrected momentum.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces DPS's direct VJP with $z = \hat x_0 - \eta g/\sqrt{\ell}$ followed by backprop of the proxy loss $\|\hat x_0 - z\|^2/(2K\eta)$; adds bias-corrected momentum on the resulting $x_t$-gradient.

name: Consistency-Gated Posterior Diffusion
tagline: Gate measurement guidance by a denoiser-stability score and combine gradients at $\hat x_0$ and a noisy mix point, with clipping and trust damping.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces DPS's single $\hat x_0$-gradient with a gate-weighted convex combination of gradients evaluated at $\hat x_0$ and at a partially-noised mix point, plus relative-residual trust damping and state clipping.

name: Manifold-projected DPS with momentum
tagline: Project the DPS gradient onto the local data-manifold tangent space, weight by denoiser confidence, and accumulate via EMA momentum.
diff_from_baseline: On top of DPS, decomposes $\nabla_{x_t}\hat x_0\cdot g$ into tangential and radial parts (radial being $x_t/s_t - \hat x_0$), shrinks the radial component, scales by a $1/(1+\|r\|/\sigma)^q$ confidence factor, and accumulates via EMA momentum.

name: DPS with EMA-normalized loss scale
tagline: Same DPS step, but normalize the guidance gradient by the EMA of $\sqrt{\ell}$ across diffusion steps instead of the per-step value.
diff_from_baseline: Single-line change to DPS: replace the per-step $1/\sqrt{\ell_{scale}}$ rescaling of the likelihood gradient with $1/\sqrt{\ell_{ref}}$, where $\ell_{ref}$ is an exponential moving average across diffusion steps.
